column4: Pixel-art game character sprite in exactly the same style as the reference image: same pixel size, same palette, same shading. It is EXACTLY the same man as in the reference, every piece of him unchanged: chubby sunburnt middle-aged man, green trucker cap, black sunglasses, a wide nasty grin with bad teeth, pale yellow T-shirt with the mountain print, a camera on a strap on his chest, a rolled green sleeping mat under his arm, a red checked flannel shirt tied round his waist, frayed denim shorts, grey socks and brown hiking boots. Now SITTING, seen from the front: thighs level, knees bent toward the viewer, lower legs straight down, boots flat on the ground, hands resting on his knees, leaning forward a little and grinning straight at the viewer, not friendly. Full body, the boots touching the bottom edge. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, no chair, no shadow, no text, no border.
